title: Rajkumari Amrit Kaur (India's first health minister)
summary: Rajkumari Amrit Kaur, born into the Kapurthala royal family, became independent India's first Minister of Health in 1947 and its first woman cabinet member. As minister she moved the 1956 bill creating the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, and from 1957 she was AIIMS's first president until her death in 1964.

uncertainty.note: Range marks her documented service as Minister of Health: appointed 1947, still minister when she moved the AIIMS Bill in February and May 1956. The date she left office is not stated on an opened page. Birth year is given as 1889 (AIIMS essay) or 1887 (other sources).
